title: How hot is each cooking step?
prompt: Place each temperature from coolest to hottest.

items.label: A refrigerator
items.fact: Keeping a fridge at 4 °C or below slows bacterial growth.

items.label: A warm bath
items.fact: A comfortable bath sits just above body temperature.

items.label: A medium steak (inside)
items.fact: Medium is reached at about 63 °C internal temperature.

items.label: Simmering water
items.fact: A simmer holds just below the rolling boil of 100 °C.

items.label: A wood-fired pizza oven
items.fact: Neapolitan pizza cooks in 90 seconds at around 430 °C.
